stories.headline: Sun Goddess wins on the Breeders' Cup opening day
stories.summary: The Breeders' Cup World Championships opened at Keeneland Race Course in Lexington, Kentucky. Sun Goddess won the Juvenile Fillies Turf, and Emphatic took the Juvenile Fillies. This is the 43rd edition of the meeting, and all 14 of its races are Grade I, run on 30 and 31 October.

stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV votes in the midterm elections
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has voted in this year's United States midterm elections. That makes him the first pontiff to vote in secular elections after taking office. He is a registered voter in Will County, Illinois, and kept voting in state and federal elections as a bishop and as a cardinal.

stories.headline: Crocodiles came through by following the warmth
stories.summary: Crocodiles and their ancient relatives spent 250 million years following warm climates rather than adapting to new ones, according to researchers led by University College London. The study drew on more than 7,000 fossils and records from over 400 living and extinct species. Warm tropical and subtropical regions stayed suitable for them after the asteroid struck, while many dinosaurs lost the environments they had.
